introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2024. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all the tasks (Task I, Task II and Task III) specified in this question paper.**

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One (booklet 0000/0595/3/Grp 1), Group Three (Grp 3) and Group Four (Grp 4); a candidate sits only ONE group. Group One: Task I (word processing, 15 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks), Task III (HTML, 15 marks). Group Three: Task 1 (word processing, 20 marks), Task 2 (spreadsheet, 15 marks), Task 3 (HTML, 15 marks). Group Four: Task I (word processing, 20 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks), Task III (C or Pascal program, 10 marks). Each group is worth 50 marks.

The working files named in the tasks (pictures, logo, signature) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.
enonce_intro_markdown:
**Task 1 (20 marks)**

The letter below is to be reproduced with a word processor. Layout of the letter: the sender's address block "Records Company, Cameroon" is on the right; "Mr. Borona, New Line Company" and "Dear Manager" are at the left margin; the title "An Application for Sponsorship" is centred, bold and underlined; the table caption "Promising Artists" is centred, bold and italic and the table is centred under it; the closing "Yours sincerely, Promotion Manager." is on the right. The first paragraph and the last paragraph are indented on their first line.

> Records Company
> Cameroon
>
> Mr. Borona
> New Line Company
>
> Dear Manager
>
> **An Application for Sponsorship**
>
> On behalf of our new promoting artists I am writing to thank you for the opportunity you are giving these new promising artists to show their talent by sponsoring three album recordings.
>
> ***Promising Artists***
>
> |   | Artist Name | Song Title |
> |---|---|---|
> | 1 | Paul Smihwe | My New Love |
> | 2 | Johnson Wewa | Once Upon A Time |

>

>
> Yours sincerely
> Promotion Manager.

questions.enonce_markdown: a) Create the letter above using the word processor on your computer. *[6 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Open the word processor and a new blank document, then build the letter from top to bottom.

1. **Sender's block**: type *Records Company* and *Cameroon* on two lines and align them to the **right** (Align Right button, or push them to the right with indents).
2. **Receiver's block**: type *Mr. Borona* and *New Line Company*, then a blank line and *Dear Manager*, all aligned on the left margin.
3. **Title**: type *An Application for Sponsorship* and underline it (Ctrl + U); it is bold and centred in the model (formatted in question c).
4. **First paragraph**: type the text beginning "On behalf of our new promoting artists ..." and indent its first line (Tab key).
5. **Table caption and table**: type *Promising Artists* (bold italic, centred), then insert a table with **3 columns and 6 rows** (Insert > Table). The first row holds the headings (the first cell empty, *Artist Name*, *Song Title*) and the next five rows hold the numbers 1 to 5, the artists' names and the song titles.
6. **Last paragraph and closing**: type "I am sure this will be a great opportunity ..." then, on the right, *Yours sincerely* and *Promotion Manager.* (leave an empty line between them for the signature of question e).

Check the spelling of the names (Paul Smihwe, Johnson Wewa, Papa John, Owaa Williams, Zolowa Poksons) and of the song titles.

Marking idea (6 marks, indicative): address blocks and salutation (1); title (1); two paragraphs typed correctly (2); table with the right number of rows and columns (1); table contents correct (1).
Click **File > Save As**, choose the candidate's folder, type the name **Task 1** and click **Save**.

questions.enonce_markdown:
c) Format the document as follows:

- Set paper size to A4; Left, Right, Top and Bottom margins to 1.5cm each. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. Open the **Layout** (Page Layout) tab, click **Size** and choose **A4** (21 cm x 29.7 cm).
2. Click **Margins > Custom Margins** and type **1.5 cm** in each of the four boxes: Top, Bottom, Left and Right. Click **OK**. (If the program warns that the margins are outside the printable area, keep the values asked in the question.)

Marking idea (2 marks): A4 paper (1); the four margins at 1.5 cm (1).

questions.enonce_markdown:
c) Format the document as follows:

- Format the title as follows: Centre Align; font size = 14 points; bold. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Select the title *An Application for Sponsorship*, click **Center** (Ctrl + E), choose the font size **14** and click **Bold** (Ctrl + B). The underline of the model can be kept.

Marking idea (2 marks): centred (1); 14 points and bold (1).

questions.enonce_markdown:
c) Format the document as follows:

- Format the body of the text as follows: Times New Roman or a similar serif font, 12 points, line spacing 1.5 and split text into two columns. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Select the body of the text (the two paragraphs of the letter, not the title nor the table).

1. Font: **Times New Roman** (a serif font), size **12**.
2. Paragraph: line spacing **1.5**.
3. **Layout > Columns > Two**: the text is split into two newspaper columns. The program puts the selected text in its own section (with continuous section breaks), so the title, the table and the closing keep their full width.

Marking idea (3 marks): serif font at 12 points (1); line spacing 1.5 (1); two columns (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: d) Centre table and table heading. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Select the caption *Promising Artists* and click **Center**. Then select the whole table (click the move handle at its top left corner) and use **Table Properties > Table > Alignment: Center** (or the Center button). The table and its heading are now in the middle of the page.

Marking idea (1 mark): both the table and its heading centred.

questions.enonce_markdown:
e) Insert the following:

- Company Name and Logo as a header. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The logo picture is supplied on the day (it is not reproduced in the question paper).

1. Double-click the top margin of the page (or **Insert > Header > Edit Header**): the header area opens.
2. Type the **company name** (*Records Company*) in the header, and centre or format it as wished.
3. In the header, click **Insert > Picture**, select the logo file given by the invigilator and click **Insert**. Resize it so that it fits in the header and stays next to the company name.
4. Close the header (**Close Header and Footer**). The name and the logo now appear at the top of the page.

Marking idea (4 marks, indicative): the header opened (1); the company name typed in the header (1); the logo inserted (1); the logo correctly sized and placed in the header (1).

questions.enonce_markdown:
e) Insert the following:

- Signature of the promotion manager between the expression "Yours sincerely" and "Promotion Manager". *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The picture of the signature is supplied on the day.

1. Click at the end of the line *Yours sincerely*, in the empty line left between *Yours sincerely* and *Promotion Manager.* (add one with Enter if needed).
2. **Insert > Picture**, select the signature file and click **Insert**; reduce it so that it fits in that space (keep the proportions) and leave the wrapping style **In line with text**.

Marking idea (2 marks): signature picture inserted (1); placed between "Yours sincerely" and "Promotion Manager" (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: f) Save your work as Task 2.
questions.corrige_markdown: Click **File > Save As** and type the name **Task 2** (the first file *Task 1* keeps the unformatted letter).
Click **File > Print**, check the preview (A4 page, header with logo, centred title and table, two-column text, signature) and click **Print**.
